_comment: Hand overrides applied by build.py after any source. Date -> title, readings [[label, citation], ...] in order, optional alt. Labels may repeat (the Easter Vigil has a psalm after each reading). Reason for each override: see README.md.

2027-03-27.title: Easter Vigil in the Holy Night
alt: Parishes may use fewer Old Testament readings.

2027-05-06.title: Thursday of the Sixth Week of Easter
alt: In the ecclesiastical provinces of Boston, Hartford, New York, Newark, Omaha and Philadelphia, the Ascension is kept today; its readings are on May 9.

2027-11-25.title: Thursday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
alt: Thanksgiving Day: parishes may use the Mass for Thanksgiving with its own readings.

2027-05-09.title: The Ascension of the Lord
alt: In most US dioceses the Ascension moves to this Sunday. Where it was kept on Thursday, May 6, today is the Seventh Sunday of Easter, with its own readings.
